criterion_text: Editing/deleting a Project or editing its default ENV file does not retroactively change an existing Session's desired/materialized binding; newly created Sessions see updated Project defaults, and explicit Session reapply remains separately owned.

verifiers.summary: Project defaults edits, ENV file edits and Project deletion left existing Session bindings and tmux environments unchanged; new Sessions saw updated defaults and explicit reapply remained the only content refresh
